title: most world cup titles.
question: Which country has won the most World Cups?

items.name: Spain
items.fact: Beat Argentina 1–0 after extra time in the 2026 final.

items.name: Argentina
items.fact: Lost the 2026 final, their fourth time as runners-up.

items.name: Germany
items.fact: Has reached a record eight World Cup finals.

items.name: Brazil
items.fact: The only team to have played at every World Cup.

ending: France and Uruguay also have two titles; only eight nations have ever won it.
